chunks: So you who believe, have endurance in suffering, be patient and persevere, strengthen each other and be firm, and be pious and fear God that you may find success.

key_terms.اتَّقُوا اللَّهَ: to fear God, to be pious
key_terms.تُفْلِحُونَ: you may succeed, you may find prosperity
key_terms.رَابِطُوا: to be stationed, to be ready (often for battle or spiritual vigilance)
key_terms.صَابِرُوا: to persevere actively, to exert effort

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of sabr, sabir, and rabt in Surah Aal Imran verse 200?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as the culmination of Surah Aal Imran, linking individual spiritual discipline with communal military readiness (rabt) under the guidance of the Imams. The triad of sabr, sabir, and rabt is interpreted to encompass patience in obedience, perseverance in hardship, and maintaining a steadfast guard against spiritual negligence. This holistic approach to taqwa ensures that believers achieve falah not only in the afterlife but also in their earthly struggles.
